safetensors_metadata.detail: header-only floating dtype distribution; no tensor payloads downloaded

base_config.detail: Publisher reference loads architecture, processor, tokenizer and generation config from this base. Phonon top-level config is an artifact manifest.

reference_modeling_code.detail: Independent, hash-checked publisher reconstruction with stock transformers==5.20.0 ParakeetForTDT; torch==2.10.0 CPU F32.

dtype.evidence: Publisher reference expands five-value, int6/int8 and fp16 records to F32. F32 GGUF preserves reconstructed values before any deployment re-quantization.

upstream_benchmarks.notes: Publisher result, not a local acceptance measurement.

reference_rationale: Publisher explicitly provides a dense Transformers oracle for this container. Execute the pinned, hash-checked publisher loader independently of the new conversion reader. Base configuration and processor are pinned separately.
known_risks: Compact download is not retained by F32 conversion. Runtime memory and latency need measurement; no publisher speed claim is inherited.
Fermion five-value sign codes, high-magnitude bits, per-row FP16 levels and int6 packing must reconstruct exactly. The unused BN num_batches_tracked counter can overflow in publisher storage.
Transformers masks invalid subsampler/encoder frames and uses a global TDT generation budget. Reuse existing metadata-controlled kestrel semantics; no model-name runtime branches.

Reference scope is stock Transformers whole-clip inference. Publisher CLI energy segmentation, hotword bias, custom kernels, MLX/CoreML and streaming wrappers are outside this conversion-first implementation.
Full acceptance-set WER and publication quantization remain separate from focused tensor and behavioral validation.

intake_gaps.reason: Top-level Phonon repository has no tokenizer/processor or architecture config. Pinned base files are authoritative per publisher reference; converter validates their values. Preflight A cannot independently read this two-repository relationship.
